questions.question: According to a US business intelligence report, who was the most popular democratic leader in July 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Global Leader Approval Rating Tracker** released by the **US-based** business intelligence firm **Morning Consult**, Indian Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** was identified as the most popular democratic leader in **July 2025**.
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** consistently secured the **top spot** with an approval rating often exceeding **70%**, significantly higher than his global counterparts from developed nations. ***Hence, option 1 is correct.***
 
• The survey tracked the approval ratings of government leaders in various countries including the **United States**, **United Kingdom**, **France**, **Australia**, and **Italy**, among others.
 
• The report highlights **India's** Prime Minister's sustained popularity, which is attributed to various **socio-economic reforms** and **diplomatic initiatives** on the international stage.
 
• **Narendra Modi** has held the **Prime Minister's office** since **May 2014**, leading the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** to consecutive victories in the **Lok Sabha** elections.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Morning Consult:**
 
 
• **Morning Consult** is a **proprietary data** and **business intelligence company** founded in **2014** and headquartered in **Washington, D.C.**
 
• The firm provides **real-time polling data** on political elections, elected officials, and corporate brands, conducting thousands of interviews across the globe daily.
 
• Their **Global Leader Approval Rating** is based on a **seven-day moving average** of all adults in a given country, with **sample sizes** varying by nation.
 
 
 
• **Other Leaders Mentioned in Options:**
 
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman:** She currently serves as the **Minister of Finance** and **Minister of Corporate Affairs** of India. While a highly influential leader, she is not typically ranked in the "Head of Government" approval surveys conducted by **Morning Consult**. ***Hence, option 2 is incorrect.***
 
• **Rahul Gandhi:** He is a prominent leader of the **Indian National Congress (INC)** and served as the **Leader of the Opposition** in the **18th Lok Sabha**. He is a key political figure but did not top the global approval rating for democratic heads of government in this report. ***Hence, option 3 is incorrect.***
 
• **Amit Shah:** He serves as the **Union Home Minister** and the first **Minister of Co-operation** of India. Like the Finance Minister, he holds a critical cabinet position but the specific "World Leader" survey focuses on the **Head of Government (Prime Minister/President)**. ***Hence, option 4 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• The rankings usually feature other notable figures like **Joe Biden** (President of the **USA**), **Justin Trudeau** (Prime Minister of **Canada**), and **Giorgia Meloni** (Prime Minister of **Italy**).
 
• A high approval rating for a democratic leader often indicates strong **public trust** and satisfaction with the **governance** and **policy implementation** within the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Data Reliability:** The **Morning Consult** data is considered a benchmark for **geopolitical sentiment**, as it uses a standardized methodology across all surveyed countries to ensure comparability.
 
• **Socio-Economic Impact:** Leaders with high approval ratings are often those who have successfully managed **inflation**, **employment**, and **national security** concerns.
 
• **Democratic Significance:** In the context of **July 2025**, these ratings reflect the **political stability** and the **electoral mandate** enjoyed by the leader in the world's largest democracy.
</ul

questions.question: Which city hosted the 2024 National Boxing Championships from 6 to 13 January?

• The championship took place from **6 January to 13 January 2024**, serving as a major platform for young pugilists in the country.
 
• The venue for this prestigious sporting event was **Invertis University**, located in **Bareilly**, which provided the necessary infrastructure for the multi-day tournament.
 
• Approximately **800 boxers** from **35 states and Union Territories** across **India** participated in various weight categories to compete for the national title.

• Top performers in these events are often drafted into the **Khelo India** scholarship scheme, which provides financial assistance and advanced training to budding sportspersons.

questions.question: In April 2025, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) came out with the operational framework for PaRRVA. What is the purpose of PaRRVA?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Verifying investment performance claims**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)** introduced the operational framework for the **Performance Reporting and Rating Verification Agency (PaRRVA)** in **April 2025** to bring transparency to the investment ecosystem.
 
• The primary objective of **PaRRVA** is the **verification of investment performance claims** made by regulated intermediaries, such as **Investment Advisers (IAs)** and **Research Analysts (RAs)**, ensuring they do not mislead investors with inflated return data. ***Hence, the correct answer is Verifying investment performance claims.***
 
• Under this framework, any performance-related claims made in advertisements or marketing materials must be validated by **PaRRVA** before being circulated to the public.
 
• The agency is designed to act as an **independent body** (often supported by subsidiaries of **Stock Exchanges**) that checks the authenticity of historical data and the methodology used to calculate returns.
 
• By mandating this verification, **SEBI** aims to curb the practice of "cherry-picking" profitable periods or using "back-tested" data to lure unsuspecting retail investors into risky financial products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI):**
 
 
• **SEBI** was established on **April 12, 1988**, and was given statutory powers on **January 30, 1992**, through the **SEBI Act, 1992**.
 
• It is the principal regulator for the securities market in **India**, headquartered in **Mumbai**, with regional offices in **New Delhi**, **Kolkata**, **Chennai**, and **Ahmedabad**.
 
• The main functions of **SEBI** include protecting the interests of investors, regulating the business in stock exchanges, and promoting the development of the securities market.
 
 
 
• **Investment Advisers and Research Analysts:**
 
 
• These entities are regulated under the **SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013** and **SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014**.
 
• They are prohibited from making **guaranteed return** claims or using superlative terms like "best" or "No. 1" without objective verification by bodies like **PaRRVA**.
 
 
 
• **Investor Protection Measures:**
 
 
• The introduction of **PaRRVA** is a step towards **investor protection**, preventing financial fraud and mis-selling in the growing digital investment advisory space.
 
• It complements other **SEBI** initiatives like the **SCORES** (SEBI Complaints Redress System) platform, which allows investors to lodge grievances against listed companies and intermediaries online.
 
 
 
• **Digital Transformation in Regulation:**
 
 
• The **PaRRVA** framework utilizes **algorithmic verification** and data feeds from **Depositories** and **Exchanges** to ensure that the reported performance matches actual transaction records.
 
• This move aligns with global best practices in financial regulation, where **independent audits** of performance track records are becoming standard for wealth management firms.
 
 
</ul

questions.question: The 11th edition of the Joint Military Exercise ‘MITRA SHAKTI‑2025’ between India and Sri Lanka was held in which of the following cities?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Belagavi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **11th edition** of the Joint Military Exercise **MITRA SHAKTI** was scheduled to be held in **Belagavi**, **Karnataka**, India.
 
• **MITRA SHAKTI** is a premier bilateral exercise conducted annually between the **Indian Army** and the **Sri Lankan Army** to bolster military cooperation.
 
• The primary objective of the **2025** edition is to enhance **interoperability** and synergy between the two nations while conducting **counter-insurgency** and **counter-terrorism** operations in a sub-conventional environment.
 
• The exercise involves the participation of infantry battalions from both sides, focusing on tactical drills and the exchange of best practices under a **United Nations mandate**.
 
• The training curriculum includes **drone warfare**, **counter-IED** (Improvised Explosive Device) techniques, and specialized operations in semi-urban terrains.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of Mitra Shakti**:
 
 
• The joint exercise series was first initiated in **2012** to build strong bilateral relations and foster mutual understanding between the security forces of **India** and **Sri Lanka**.
 
• It has since evolved into a critical platform for sharing operational experiences gained during various **peacekeeping** missions and internal security duties.
 
 
 
• **10th Edition Recap**:
 
 
• The **10th edition** of Exercise Mitra Shakti was successfully conducted in **August 2024** at the Army Training School in **Maduru Oya**, **Sri Lanka**.
 
• This edition saw a significant focus on **Hadr** (Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief) operations and joint tactical planning.
 
 
 
• **SLINEX (Sri Lanka-India Naval Exercise)**:
 
 
• Apart from the army exercise, the two countries participate in a bilateral maritime exercise called **SLINEX**.
 
• Launched in **2005**, **SLINEX** aims to enhance **maritime security** and promote technical coordination between the **Indian Navy** and the **Sri Lanka Navy**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Significance**: These exercises are a cornerstone of India’s **“Neighbourhood First”** policy and the **SAGAR** (Security and Growth for All in the Region) vision, aimed at maintaining peace in the **Indian Ocean Region**.
 
• **Belagavi Training Hub**: **Belagavi** (formerly Belgaum) is a significant military base in India, housing the **Maratha Light Infantry Regimental Centre (MLIRC)** and the **Junior Leaders Wing** of the Infantry School, making it an ideal location for international **joint exercises**.
 
• **Scope of Operations**: The drills often include **sniping**, **combat conditioning**, **rappelling**, and **medical evacuation** drills to ensure readiness for diverse combat scenarios.
</ul

questions.question: In 2025, which ministry launched the Trade Intelligence and Analytics Portal to offer transparent and real-time trade data?

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Commerce and Industry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Commerce and Industry** officially launched the **Trade Intelligence and Analytics Portal** in **January 2025** to empower Indian exporters with data-driven decision-making tools.
 
• The portal was inaugurated by the Union Minister of Commerce and Industry, **Shri Piyush Goyal**, as part of the government's **digital transformation** agenda for the trade sector.
 
• It serves as a comprehensive platform providing **transparent** and **real-time trade data**, which includes detailed information on **export-import statistics**, **global market trends**, and **trade flows**.
 
• The portal integrates **Advanced Analytics** and **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** to provide insights into **Non-Tariff Barriers (NTBs)**, **Rules of Origin**, and **tariff structures** across more than **200 international markets**.
 
• The primary objective of this initiative is to assist **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)** and large exporters in identifying new opportunities to help India achieve its target of **$2 trillion in exports** by **2030**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT):** Functioning under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, the **DGFT** is responsible for formulating and implementing the **Foreign Trade Policy (FTP)** and promoting India's exports through various digital schemes.
 
• **Foreign Trade Policy (FTP) 2023:** This policy shifted India's approach from an **incentive-based** regime to a **remission and entitlement-based** regime, emphasizing **Ease of Doing Business** through automation and paperless processing.
 
• **Export Targets:** The Indian government has set a long-term goal to reach **$1 trillion in merchandise exports** and **$1 trillion in services exports** by the year **2030**, supported by initiatives like the **Trade Intelligence Portal**.
 
• **India's Trade Ecosystem:** Key bodies such as **Export Promotion Councils (EPCs)** and **Commodity Boards** work under the aegis of this ministry to support specific sectors like **pharmaceuticals**, **engineering goods**, and **textiles**.
 
• **Market Access Initiative (MAI) Scheme:** This is an export promotion scheme that provides financial assistance to export promotion organizations and individual exporters for **market studies**, **branding**, and participation in **international trade fairs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The portal acts as a **single-window solution** for exporters to access **HS Code-wise** (Harmonized System) data and **market intelligence**, which was previously scattered across multiple platforms.
 
• By providing **predictive analytics**, the ministry helps businesses stay ahead of **global supply chain disruptions** and shifting **geopolitical trade dynamics**.
 
• The **Department of Commerce**, which manages this portal, is also the lead agency for negotiating **Free Trade Agreements (FTAs)** with countries like the **UK**, **European Union**, and members of the **GCC** to expand India's global footprint.
</ul

• The first-ever winner of the **Orange Cap** was **Shaun Marsh**, who scored **616 runs** for Kings XI Punjab in the inaugural season.

• The franchise is based in **Ahmedabad**, **Gujarat**, and plays its home matches at the **Narendra Modi Stadium**.

• **Sai Sudharsan** reaching **759 runs** highlights the rising importance of young Indian domestic talent in a league that features the best international cricketers.

questions.question: Which international joint naval exercise in a disputed maritime region raised eyebrows in 2025?

options.text: India–Philippines naval drill in the South China Sea
Exercise Ajeya Warrior in the Bay of Bengal
Iron Fist Drill with Russia in the Indian Ocean
Exercise Malabar with India and Australia near the Malacca Strait

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India–Philippines naval drill in the South China Sea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **India–Philippines naval drill** conducted in the **South China Sea** in **2025** represents a significant escalation in bilateral defense ties and a shift in **India’s maritime strategy**. This exercise was aimed at enhancing **interoperability** and demonstrating a commitment to **freedom of navigation** in international waters. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The drill took place within the **Philippines' Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ)**, a region where **China** asserts expansive territorial claims under its controversial **Nine-Dash Line**. By conducting maneuvers here, **India** signaled its support for the **2016 Permanent Court of Arbitration** ruling.
 
• This joint exercise involved advanced naval assets, including **guided-missile frigates** and **maritime patrol aircraft**, focusing on **anti-submarine warfare (ASW)** and surface gunnery drills.
 
• **Exercise Ajeya Warrior** is a bilateral **Army exercise** between **India** and the **United Kingdom**, not a naval exercise in the **Bay of Bengal**. It focuses on counter-terrorism and tactical operations. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
 
• The **Iron Fist Drill** is historically a joint amphibious exercise between the **United States** and **Japan**; it does not traditionally involve **Russia** in the **Indian Ocean** as a joint "Iron Fist" branded partner for India. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***
 
• **Exercise Malabar** is a multilateral naval exercise involving **India, Australia, Japan, and the USA** (the **QUAD**). While it occurs in the Indo-Pacific, the specific "eyebrow-raising" event in a **disputed maritime region** in **2025** specifically refers to the burgeoning **India-Philippines** security nexus in the **South China Sea**. ***Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India–Philippines Defense Relations**:
 
 
• The relationship has transformed from a primarily commercial one to a **strategic partnership**. A milestone in this journey was the **2024 delivery** of the **BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles** to the **Philippines**, worth **$375 million**.
 
• In **2025**, both nations expanded their **Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Defense Cooperation** to include joint patrols and intelligence sharing.
 
 
 
• **Geopolitics of the South China Sea**:
 
 
• The **South China Sea** is a critical maritime gateway through which approximately **one-third** of global shipping passes, valued at over **$3 trillion** annually.
 
• The **United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)** serves as the legal framework for maritime rights, which **India** consistently advocates for to ensure a **rules-based international order**.
 
 
 
• **India’s Act East Policy**:
 
 
• Launched in **2014** by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, this policy focuses on the extended neighborhood in the **Asia-Pacific region**. It has evolved from economic integration to include **security and defense cooperation** with **ASEAN** member states.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Exercise Malabar**: This was originally a **bilateral exercise** between **India** and the **USA** in **1992**. It became **trilateral** with the inclusion of **Japan** in **2015** and **quadrilateral** with **Australia** rejoining in **2020**. It serves as a visual deterrent and a mechanism for **QUAD nations** to ensure a **Free and Open Indo-Pacific**.
 
• **Freedom of Navigation Operations (FONOPs)**: While India does not officially join U.S.-led FONOPs, its presence in the **South China Sea** through joint drills with **littoral states** like the **Philippines** and **Vietnam** serves a similar purpose of asserting **maritime sovereignty** and international law.
 
• **INS Kadmatt and INS Shivalik**: These are examples of **Indian Navy** ships that have been frequently deployed for **Long Range Operational Deployments** in the **South China Sea** to engage with friendly foreign navies.

questions.question: In September 2025, TDK Corporation inaugurated its Advanced Technologies Lithium-ion Battery Manufacturing Plant in which Indian state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **September 2025**, the **Japanese** electronics giant **TDK Corporation** inaugurated its first state-of-the-art facility for manufacturing **Lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery cells** in India.
 
• The manufacturing plant is located in **Manesar**, which falls under the **Gurugram** district of the state of **Haryana**.
 
• This facility is specifically designed to produce high-end battery cells that will be supplied to major global technology companies, most notably for the assembly of **Apple iPhones** within India.
 
• The establishment of this plant in **Haryana** marks a significant shift in the global supply chain, as **TDK Corporation** previously imported these cells primarily from **China**.
 
• The project is a major boost to the **"Make in India"** initiative, aiming to increase domestic value addition in the electronics and mobile phone manufacturing sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **TDK Corporation:** It is a leading **Japanese** multinational electronics company founded in **1935**, with its global headquarters in **Tokyo**. The company is world-renowned for its expertise in magnetic materials and electronic components.
 
• **Employment Generation:** The inauguration of the **Haryana** plant is expected to create several thousand direct and indirect **jobs**, fostering local economic growth in the **Manesar-Bawal** industrial corridor.
 
• **Investment Impact:** This move by **TDK Corporation** signifies **India’s** growing status as a preferred destination for **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)** in high-tech manufacturing, particularly for the components used in premium smartphones.

questions.question: As per the new Know Your Customer (KYC) relaxations of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) notified in May 2025, low‑risk customers are allowed to continue transactions without KYC until _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**30 June 2026**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, in a notification issued in **May 2025**, announced significant relaxations in the **Know Your Customer (KYC)** updation norms to enhance customer convenience and ensure the continuity of financial services.
 
• As per the new guidelines, **low-risk customers** are allowed to continue their banking transactions without a fresh **KYC** update until **30 June 2026**, even if their periodic updation is currently due.
 
• This extension is specifically aimed at **low-risk** individuals who have not had any change in their identification or address details, allowing them to provide a **self-declaration** through digital channels instead of visiting a branch.
 
• The primary objective behind this move is to reduce the administrative burden on **Regulated Entities (REs)** and prevent the sudden freezing of bank accounts, which often causes distress to genuine customers.
 
• The **RBI** has encouraged **banks** and other **financial institutions** to utilize **V-CIP (Video-based Customer Identification Process)** and other non-face-to-face channels to complete the **re-KYC** process before the revised deadline.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Understanding KYC (Know Your Customer):**
 
 
• **KYC** is a mandatory process for **financial institutions** to verify the identity and address of their customers to prevent **money laundering**, **terrorist financing**, and other illegal activities.
 
• It involves the submission of **Officially Valid Documents (OVDs)** such as **Aadhaar**, **Passport**, **Voter ID**, or **Driving License**.
 
 
 
• **Risk Categorization in Banking:**
 
 
• Customers are categorized into **High**, **Medium**, and **Low** risk based on their profile, occupation, and nature of transactions.
 
• Traditionally, **High-risk** customers require a **KYC** update every **2 years**, **Medium-risk** every **8 years**, and **Low-risk** every **10 years**.
 
• The **May 2025** relaxation specifically targets the **Low-risk** category to simplify their compliance journey.
 
 
 
• **The Role of PMLA:**
 
 
• The **KYC** guidelines are framed under the **Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002**, and the **Prevention of Money Laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005**.
 
• Compliance with these rules is essential for the stability and integrity of the **Indian financial system**.
 
 
 
• **Digital KYC and V-CIP:**
 
 
• The **V-CIP** is a method of customer identification by an official of the **Regulated Entity** by undertaking a seamless, secure, real-time, online video call with the customer.
 
• It has become a popular alternative to physical visits, especially for **re-KYC** and opening new accounts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Self-Declaration Policy:** For **low-risk customers**, if there is no change in **KYC** information, a **self-declaration** submitted through **registered email-id**, **registered mobile number**, **ATMs**, or **mobile apps** is sufficient for **re-KYC**.
 
• **Regulated Entities (REs):** These include **Commercial Banks**, **Regional Rural Banks**, **Cooperative Banks**, **NBFCs**, and **Payment System Operators** regulated by the **RBI**.
 
• **Account Freezing Rules:** **RBI** has reiterated that accounts should not be frozen routinely without providing adequate notice and multiple reminders to the customer regarding **KYC** pendency.
 
• **Master Direction:** The overarching rules are governed by the **RBI Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016**, which is periodically updated to reflect changes in technology and **regulatory policy**.
</ul

• By securing the victory at **Augusta National Golf Club**, he joined an elite group of legendary golfers who have won all four modern major championships: **Gene Sarazen**, **Ben Hogan**, **Gary Player**, **Jack Nicklaus**, and **Tiger Woods**.
 
• The **Masters Tournament** was the final piece of the puzzle for **McIlroy**, who had been seeking the elusive **Green Jacket** for over a decade to complete his collection of major trophies.

questions.question: In July 2025, which panel has suggested revising the ‘Guidelines for declaration of ESZ, 2011' issued by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)?

options.text: The Standing Committee of National Tiger Conservation Authority
The Standing Committee of the National Board for Wildlife
The Standing Committee of Central Pollution Control Board
The Standing Committee of Ministry of Rural Development

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The Standing Committee of the National Board for Wildlife**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Standing Committee of the National Board for Wildlife (NBWL)**, in its meeting held in **July 2025**, recommended a comprehensive revision of the **‘Guidelines for declaration of Eco-Sensitive Zones (ESZ), 2011'**.
 
• The original **2011 Guidelines** were issued by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** to provide a framework for designating buffer zones around **National Parks** and **Wildlife Sanctuaries**.
 
• The decision to revise the guidelines stems from the need to streamline the **ESZ notification process** and address the administrative and legal challenges faced over the last decade.
 
• The committee highlighted that the updated guidelines would aim to better balance the **ecological integrity** of protected areas with the **socio-economic development** and **livelihood rights** of local communities residing in these zones. ***Hence, statement 2 is the correct answer.***
 
• The revision is expected to provide clearer definitions of **prohibited**, **regulated**, and **permitted activities**, ensuring that **conservation goals** are met without causing undue hardship to the public.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Board for Wildlife (NBWL):**
 
 
• It is a **statutory body** constituted under **Section 5A** of the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**.
 
• The board is chaired by the **Prime Minister of India**, while the **Standing Committee** is chaired by the **Minister of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**.
 
• It serves as the apex body for all **wildlife-related matters**, including the approval of projects inside and around **Protected Areas**.
 
 
 
• **Eco-Sensitive Zones (ESZ):**
 
 
• ESZs are areas notified by the **MoEFCC** under the **Environment (Protection) Act, 1986**.
 
• The primary objective is to create "**shock absorbers**" for protected areas by regulating human activities in the immediate vicinity.
 
• Generally, an **ESZ** can extend up to **10 kilometers** around a **National Park** or **Wildlife Sanctuary**, though this distance can be increased or decreased based on specific ecological requirements.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Regulatory Framework of ESZ:**
 
 
• **Prohibited Activities:** These include **commercial mining**, setting up of **sawmills**, polluting industries, and major **hydroelectric projects**.
 
• **Regulated Activities:** These include the **felling of trees**, establishment of **hotels and resorts**, drastic change of agriculture systems, and the commercial use of **natural water resources**.
 
• **Permitted Activities:** These include **ongoing agriculture** and **horticulture practices** by local communities, **rainwater harvesting**, and the use of **renewable energy sources**.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Interventions:** In **2022**, the **Supreme Court of India** mandated a minimum **1 km ESZ** for all protected areas, though this was later modified in **2023** to allow for area-specific flexibility, emphasizing that **rigid boundaries** may not be practical for every geographical location.

questions.question: Which of the following was the first integrated multi-state mock drill in Delhi-NCR, simulating a large-scale earthquake across 55 locations, conducted from 1 August 2025?

__
 
• **Exercise Suraksha Chakra** was the first major integrated **multi-state mock drill** conducted across the **Delhi-NCR** region, specifically designed to simulate a high-intensity **earthquake** scenario.
 
• The drill commenced on **1 August 2025** and was carried out simultaneously at **55 locations** throughout the **National Capital Region (NCR)**, including sensitive areas in **Delhi**, **Uttar Pradesh**, and **Haryana**.
 
• The primary objective of this exercise was to evaluate the **disaster preparedness**, **inter-state coordination**, and **response time** of various administrative and emergency services during a large-scale natural calamity.
 
• The exercise was organized under the aegis of the **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)** in collaboration with the **Delhi Disaster Management Authority (DDMA)** and state-level disaster response units.
 
• This integrated drill focused on testing the **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)** for emergency communication, debris clearance, medical triage, and the rescue of trapped individuals from high-rise buildings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Seismic Vulnerability of Delhi-NCR:** 
 
 
• The **Delhi-NCR** region falls under **Seismic Zone IV**, which is categorized as a **High Damage Risk Zone**. Proximity to active fault lines like the **Sohna Fault** and the **Mahendragarh-Dehradun Fault** necessitates frequent simulations like **Exercise Suraksha Chakra**.
 
 
 
• **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA):** 
 
 
• Headed by the **Prime Minister of India**, the **NDMA** is the apex body for disaster management, established under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**. Its role is to lay down policies and guidelines for ensuring timely and effective responses to disasters.
 
 
 
• **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF):** 
 
 
• The **NDRF** played a pivotal role in **Exercise Suraksha Chakra**. Established in **2006**, it is a specialized force consisting of **12 battalions** (as of recent data) trained for **natural and man-made disasters** including **CBRN** (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear) emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Exercises:** 
 
 
• While **Exercise Suraksha Chakra** is an internal disaster drill, **Exercise Surya Kiran** is a periodic **bilateral military exercise** conducted between the **Indian Army** and the **Nepalese Army**, primarily focusing on jungle warfare and counter-insurgency operations.
 
 
 
• **Technological Integration:** 
 
 
• The drill utilized advanced tools such as **Geographic Information Systems (GIS)**, **drones** for damage assessment, and **satellite-based communication** systems to ensure connectivity when traditional networks fail during an **earthquake**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Multi-Agency Participation:** The drill saw active involvement from the **Indian Army**, **Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs)**, local **Police Departments**, **Fire Services**, and major **Hospitals** in the **NCR**.
 
• **Public Awareness:** A critical component of **Exercise Suraksha Chakra** was the **community participation** segment, where residents were educated on **"Drop, Cover, and Hold On"** techniques and the identification of **emergency assembly points**.
 
• **Reporting and Feedback:** Post-exercise, an **After-Action Report (AAR)** was drafted to identify gaps in **inter-departmental logistics** and to refine the **Disaster Management Plans** of the involved states.
</ul

questions.question: What was the theme of India’s 76th Republic Day celebrated on 26 January 2025?

__
 
• India celebrated its **76th Republic Day** on **January 26, 2025**, with great fervor and national pride.
 
• The central theme for the **2025** celebrations was **"Swarnim Bharat: Virasat aur Vikas"**, which translates to **"Golden India: Heritage and Development"**.
 
• The theme was chosen to reflect India's dual commitment to preserving its rich **cultural heritage** (Virasat) while striving for rapid **modern development** (Vikas) towards the goal of **Viksit Bharat by 2047**.
 
• The Republic Day parade was held at the iconic **Kartavya Path** in **New Delhi**, showcasing the nation's military prowess, indigenous defense equipment, and diverse cultural tableaux.
 
• The celebration marked the **75th anniversary** of the adoption of the **Constitution of India**, emphasizing the strength of Indian democracy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Significance:** Republic Day commemorates the date on which the **Constitution of India** came into effect on **January 26, 1950**. While the Constitution was adopted on **November 26, 1949**, the **26th of January** was chosen because it was on this day in **1930** that the **Purna Swaraj** (Complete Independence) declaration was promulgated by the **Indian National Congress**.
 
• **Viksit Bharat @2047:** This is the government's vision to transform India into a **developed nation** by the **centenary of its independence** in **2047**. The **2025 theme** aligns with this long-term objective of economic growth and global leadership.
 
• **Chief Guest Tradition:** Every year, India invites a world leader as the **Chief Guest** for the Republic Day parade. For the **2025** celebrations, **President Mohamed Muizzu** of the **Maldives** was invited, highlighting India's **"Neighborhood First"** policy and maritime security cooperation.
 
• **Previous Themes:** In **2024**, during the **75th Republic Day**, the themes were **"Viksit Bharat"** and **"Bharat - Loktantra ki Matruka"** (India - Mother of Democracy), focusing on women-led development and democratic values.
 
• **Beating Retreat Ceremony:** The Republic Day festivities conclude with the **Beating Retreat** ceremony on the evening of **January 29** at **Vijay Chowk**, featuring performances by the bands of the **Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Constitutional Head:** The **President of India**, currently **Droupadi Murmu**, unfurls the **National Flag** and takes the salute during the parade, as the President is the **Constitutional Head** of the State.
 
• **Padma Awards:** On the eve of Republic Day, the **Government of India** announces the **Padma Awards**, which are among the highest civilian honors in the country, categorized into **Padma Vibhushan**, **Padma Bhushan**, and **Padma Shri**.
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:** Recent parades have emphasized **indigenization**, featuring only **Made-in-India** weapon systems like the **LCH Prachand**, **K-9 Vajra**, and **Nag** anti-tank guided missiles to showcase self-reliance in defense.
</ul

questions.question: Which of the following volcanoes, located in Ethiopia, was in the news in November 2025 for erupting for the first time in recorded history?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hayli Gubbi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hayli Gubbi** is a **shield volcano** located at the southern end of the **Erta Ale volcanic range** in the **Afar Region** of **Ethiopia**.
 
• In **November 2025**, the volcano garnered significant attention from the global scientific community after it erupted for the **first time in recorded history**. Prior to this event, the volcano was primarily known for its **fumarolic activity** and was considered relatively quiet compared to its neighbors.
 
• The volcano reaches an **elevation** of approximately **521 meters** (**1,709 feet**) and is situated within the **Danakil Depression**, a tectonic plate junction that is one of the lowest and hottest places on **Earth**.
 
• This eruption is geologically significant because it provides new evidence regarding the **magmatic processes** occurring within the **Afar Triple Junction**, where the **Nubian**, **Somali**, and **Arabian tectonic plates** are pulling away from each other.
 
• Volcanologists monitor this region closely as the **Erta Ale range** is one of the most active volcanic chains in **Africa**, though **Hayli Gubbi** specifically had no prior historical record of a major **lava-producing eruption**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mount Semeru:**
 
 
• Located in **East Java**, **Indonesia**, **Mount Semeru** is the highest mountain on the island of **Java**.
 
• It is an active **stratovolcano** known for its frequent eruptions, often producing **pyroclastic flows** and **lahars** that pose significant risks to local populations.
 
• It is a prominent feature of the **Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park** and has been erupting almost continuously since **1967**.
 
 
 
• **Kilauea:**
 
 
• Situated on the **Big Island** of **Hawaii**, **USA**, **Kilauea** is one of the most active **shield volcanoes** in the world.
 
• It is a **hotspot volcano**, meaning it is not located on a plate boundary but over a plume of **magma** rising through the **Earth's crust**.
 
• It is famous for its **effusive eruptions** and long-standing **lava lakes**, and it is a central part of the **Hawaii Volcanoes National Park**.
 
 
 
• **Krasheninnikov:**
 
 
• This is a complex **volcanic system** located on the **Kamchatka Peninsula** in **Russia**.
 
• It consists of two overlapping **stratovolcanoes** housed within a large **caldera** formed during the **late Pleistocene** epoch.
 
• The **Kamchatka** region is part of the **Pacific Ring of Fire** and contains one of the highest concentrations of active volcanoes in the world.
 
 
 
• **Volcanism in Ethiopia:**
 
 
• **Ethiopia** is home to more than **60 volcanoes**, many of which are located along the **Great Rift Valley**.
 
• The **Erta Ale** volcano, also in the **Afar region**, is the most famous in the country, known for its persistent **lava lake** that has been active for decades.
 
• The **tectonic activity** in this region is slowly splitting the **African continent** apart, a process that will eventually lead to the formation of a new **ocean basin**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Geological Context:** The eruption of **Hayli Gubbi** in **2025** serves as a reminder of the unpredictable nature of **dormant volcanoes** in **rift zones**.
 
• **Data Monitoring:** Modern **satellite technology** and **seismic sensors** allow researchers to detect changes in **ground deformation** and **gas emissions**, which preceded the historical eruption of this Ethiopian volcano.
 
• **Afar Triangle:** This region is unique because it is the only place on **Earth** where a **mid-ocean ridge** can be studied on land, making the activity of volcanoes like **Hayli Gubbi** vital for **geophysical research**.
